summary: This joint resolution proposes a constitutional amendment to require a balanced federal budget, limit spending to a percentage of the gross domestic product, restrict increases to the public debt and revenue, and mandate that federal agencies justify their funding requests.

scores.thoughts: This bill proposes a constitutional amendment that would cap total outlays at a percentage of GDP and require a balanced budget, significantly restricting future government spending. It also mandates justification for all agency funding, aiming to reduce unnecessary expenditures.

The bill requires a three-fifths majority in both houses of Congress to pass any bill that increases revenue, making it significantly harder to raise taxes. This directly impacts the ability to increase taxation.

The core of this bill is a balanced budget amendment, which directly aims to prevent deficit spending and reduce the national debt. It also requires a three-fifths majority to increase the debt limit, strongly prioritizing debt reduction.
